claude_result_report.name: ENTITYOS_CLAUDE_RESULTS_2026-08-25.pdf
claude_result_report.operator_reported: Claude Code coordinator plus Rocky plus Bruno
claude_result_report.scope_warning: The report is research input for training-example construction. It is not promoted here to canonical runtime truth and its source head is older than the branch base main.

observed_reported_findings.reported: 4 of 24 suites were closed: T00 PASS, T01 FAIL_SCIENTIFIC, T05 INCOMPLETE, T06 FAIL_SCIENTIFIC; T02-T04 and T07-T23 were NOT_RUN.
observed_reported_findings.training_consequence: Teach exact status boundaries: NOT_RUN is not PASS and whole-product acceptance cannot be inferred from partial P0 execution.

observed_reported_findings.reported: Matched internal target coordinate 4.25 versus 0.25 controls and sign flip -4.17, while held-out target-code hit remained 33.3% matched versus 33.3% baseline with diagonal advantage -0.051.
observed_reported_findings.training_consequence: Teach that causal internal transport or instrumentation can exist without semantic behavioral control. Do not promote semantic J-Space from internal-coordinate actuation alone.

observed_reported_findings.reported: Absolute nuisance-control behavioral effect 0.155 exceeded semantic-condition effect 0.052.
observed_reported_findings.training_consequence: Teach fail-closed selectivity: a nuisance control outperforming the intended effect blocks the stronger causal claim.

observed_reported_findings.reported: Prompt-byte and token-tensor hashing exist, but no single artifact jointly binds them; token-tensor identity drops dtype and shape; the six-condition cross-binding lineage is not the live promotion lineage.
observed_reported_findings.training_consequence: Teach one exact consumed-input identity joining prompt bytes, tensor values/order/dtype/shape, model/runtime, family topology and the actual promoted path.

observed_reported_findings.reported: Live CI/runner uses the older unversioned promotion gate v4 while v5-v13 have no non-test callers; v13 additionally requires abstract_state_raw_evidence with no producer.
observed_reported_findings.training_consequence: Teach call-path reachability and end-to-end gate completeness; stricter dead code is not a live safeguard, and newest version is not automatically canonical.

observed_reported_findings.reported: Live gate accepts self-declared independence, format-checks control hashes without recomputing bytes, checks matched-control completeness at candidate rather than family scope, and omits wrong-layer/lesion/rescue requirements.
observed_reported_findings.training_consequence: Teach independent evidence recomputation, byte-bound receipt integrity, per-family control completeness and mechanism-specific controls on the retained promotion path.

observed_reported_findings.reported: An earlier attempt failed before the experiment due to GitHub public-key authentication and a stale checkout; the later session repaired the read-only source path and refreshed source.
observed_reported_findings.training_consequence: Teach transport/source failures as infrastructure evidence with zero scientific credit, and require exact current source identity before current-state claims.

swarm.round_1_candidate: Add positive J-Space examples because the intervention clearly moved an internal coordinate.
swarm.round_1_reason: The reported held-out behavioral criterion failed and a nuisance control moved behavior more than the intended semantic arm. Positive semantic/J-Space labels would invert the evidence.
swarm.round_2_candidate: Convert the negative findings into evidence-metrology hard negatives and method examples while preserving the separate Qwen3.5 dynamic-binding curriculum.
swarm.round_2_reason: This trains the 0.8B candidate to classify evidence, provenance and promotion boundaries without transferring Qwen3-0.6B vector coordinates or pretending the reported PDF is canonical runtime authority.

candidate_gate_review.method: Static predicate review against tools/entityos_hcu_trainingtrace_candidate_gate_v1.py at branch base; no repository-runtime execution claimed.

research_return.new_training_rule: A trained Xeno must learn not only the intended cognitive operation but the evidence boundary that decides whether an observed internal change is allowed to become a causal claim.
research_return.new_architecture_implication: Promotion metrology must be part of the operational cognition curriculum: exact source identity, live-call-path identity, consumed-input identity and matched-control topology are first-class state, not post-hoc report decoration.
research_return.new_counterhypothesis: If post-training binding accuracy improves while evidence-classification hard negatives regress, the model may have learned task shortcuts while becoming less safe as a research organ; binding accuracy alone is then insufficient for promotion.
research_return.next_falsifier: Evaluate the future Qwen3.5 checkpoint on frozen paired examples where identical internal-coordinate evidence must lead to different verdicts depending on behavioral outcome, nuisance-control dominance, provenance completeness and live-gate reachability.

next_exact_actions: Fuse this 18-row metrology family with the already-current dynamic-binding seed only at dataset-mixture planning level; do not let metrology rows replace the binding curriculum.
Materialize the exact 46-atom counterbalanced 72-row binding seed under the current V3 atom/split gates before scaling.

Create a frozen metrology evaluation split with adversarial near-miss pairs: internal transport plus behavior fail, intended effect plus stronger nuisance effect, strict source gate present but unreachable, and hashes syntactically valid but not recomputed.
Do not mint positive Qwen3.5 J-Space labels until same-model causal behavioral receipts exist.
